summary: Homestead should retain a standalone municipal control row. Official city materials show a live Homestead Police Department and current city-run police governance, while FDLE's 2021 county-and-municipal report still published Homestead as a normal municipal police row. The current all-fill state is not an invalid-target or county-service-structure problem; it reflects a 2024 reporting gap, with the public FDLE 2024 workbook lacking a Homestead row and the official FBI CDE roster assigning Homestead Police Department a NIBRS start date of January 1, 2025.
